entries.name: fig-auditor-rep--action-present--expr-deadpan
entries.instruction: ARM COUNT IS LOAD-BEARING: this figure has exactly TWO arms - one presenting arm held out from the shoulder with the palm turned up, plus ONE other arm; no third limb, no extra shoulder, no spare sleeve, no duplicated forearm anywhere in the frame. entries.name: fig-qt-wiles--action-armscrossed--expr-crestfallen
entries.instruction: HEAD TONE IS LOAD-BEARING: the face and both hands render in exactly the SAME warm cream head tone as the canonical seed - one flat uniform warm tone across face, neck and every exposed hand. Do NOT lighten, cool, grey, desaturate or wash out the skin; no pale porcelain, no cool grey-blue cast, no blush. Arms crossed at the chest, exactly TWO arms and no third limb.
